notes: Placeholders {subscription} and {target_rg} are replaced at runtime. Every query must return the columns resourceId (string), compliant (bool) and observed (dynamic). Azure Policy names are given only where a built-in definition with the same meaning is expected; verify them in the portal before citing.

controls.name: Privileged access rights
controls.criterion: No direct Owner role assignments at the scope of the monitored resource group
controls.query: authorizationresources | where type =~ 'microsoft.authorization/roleassignments' | extend scope = tolower(tostring(properties.scope)), roleDef = tolower(tostring(properties.roleDefinitionId)) | where scope == tolower('/subscriptions/{subscription}/resourceGroups/{target_rg}') | summarize owners = countif(roleDef endswith '8e3af657-a8ff-443c-a75c-2fe8c4bcb635') | project resourceId = '/subscriptions/{subscription}/resourceGroups/{target_rg}', compliant = (owners == 0), observed = pack('directOwnerAssignments', owners)

controls.name: Information access restriction
controls.azurePolicyEquivalent: Storage account public access should be disallowed
controls.query: resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts' and resourceGroup =~ '{target_rg}' | extend p = tobool(properties.allowBlobPublicAccess) | project resourceId = id, compliant = (isnotnull(p) and p == false), observed = pack('allowBlobPublicAccess', p)

controls.name: Secure authentication
controls.azurePolicyEquivalent: Storage accounts should prevent shared key access
controls.query: resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts' and resourceGroup =~ '{target_rg}' | extend p = tobool(properties.allowSharedKeyAccess) | project resourceId = id, compliant = (isnotnull(p) and p == false), observed = pack('allowSharedKeyAccess', p)

controls.name: Configuration management
controls.criterion: Every resource in the monitored resource group has the tags owner and environment
controls.query: resources | where resourceGroup =~ '{target_rg}' | extend o = tostring(tags['owner']), e = tostring(tags['environment']) | project resourceId = id, compliant = (isnotempty(o) and isnotempty(e)), observed = pack('owner', o, 'environment', e)

controls.name: Information backup
controls.azurePolicyEquivalent: Key vaults should have deletion protection enabled
controls.query: resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.keyvault/vaults' and resourceGroup =~ '{target_rg}' | extend p = tobool(properties.enablePurgeProtection) | project resourceId = id, compliant = (p == true), observed = pack('enablePurgeProtection', p)

controls.name: Logging
controls.query: resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces' and resourceGroup =~ '{target_rg}' | extend r = toint(properties.retentionInDays) | project resourceId = id, compliant = (r >= 90), observed = pack('retentionInDays', r)

controls.name: Monitoring activities
controls.criterion: At least one enabled activity log alert for Microsoft.Network/networkSecurityGroups/write exists
controls.azurePolicyEquivalent: An activity log alert should exist for specific Administrative operations
controls.query: resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.insights/activitylogalerts' and resourceGroup =~ '{target_rg}' | extend en = tobool(properties.enabled) | mv-expand c = properties.condition.allOf | where tostring(c.field) =~ 'operationName' and tostring(c.equals) =~ 'Microsoft.Network/networkSecurityGroups/write' | summarize enabledAlerts = countif(en == true) | project resourceId = '/subscriptions/{subscription}/resourceGroups/{target_rg}', compliant = (enabledAlerts > 0), observed = pack('enabledNsgWriteAlerts', enabledAlerts)

controls.name: Networks security
controls.criterion: No inbound Allow rule from Internet/any to port 22 or 3389
controls.query: resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.network/networksecuritygroups' and resourceGroup =~ '{target_rg}' | extend rules = iff(array_length(properties.securityRules) > 0, properties.securityRules, dynamic([{}])) | mv-expand r = rules | extend acc = tostring(r.properties.access), dir = tostring(r.properties.direction), src = tostring(r.properties.sourceAddressPrefix), port = tostring(r.properties.destinationPortRange), ports = tostring(r.properties.destinationPortRanges) | extend bad = (acc =~ 'Allow' and dir =~ 'Inbound' and src in~ ('*', 'Internet', '0.0.0.0/0', 'Any') and (port in ('22', '3389', '*') or ports has '"22"' or ports has '"3389"')) | summarize openRules = countif(bad) by resourceId = id | project resourceId, compliant = (openRules == 0), observed = pack('openManagementRules', openRules)

controls.name: Security of network services
controls.criterion: Key Vault publicNetworkAccess = Disabled or networkAcls.defaultAction = Deny
controls.azurePolicyEquivalent: Azure Key Vault should disable public network access
controls.query: resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.keyvault/vaults' and resourceGroup =~ '{target_rg}' | extend pna = tostring(properties.publicNetworkAccess), da = tostring(properties.networkAcls.defaultAction) | project resourceId = id, compliant = (pna =~ 'Disabled' or da =~ 'Deny'), observed = pack('publicNetworkAccess', pna, 'defaultAction', da)

controls.name: Segregation of networks
controls.criterion: Every subnet is associated with a network security group
controls.azurePolicyEquivalent: Subnets should be associated with a Network Security Group
controls.query: resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.network/virtualnetworks' and resourceGroup =~ '{target_rg}' | mv-expand s = properties.subnets | extend nsg = tostring(s.properties.networkSecurityGroup.id) | project resourceId = tostring(s.id), compliant = isnotempty(nsg), observed = pack('networkSecurityGroup', nsg)

controls.name: Use of cryptography
controls.criterion: Storage account minimumTlsVersion = TLS1_2 and supportsHttpsTrafficOnly = true
controls.azurePolicyEquivalent: Secure transfer to storage accounts should be enabled
controls.query: resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts' and resourceGroup =~ '{target_rg}' | extend tls = tostring(properties.minimumTlsVersion), https = tobool(properties.supportsHttpsTrafficOnly) | project resourceId = id, compliant = (tls == 'TLS1_2' and https == true), observed = pack('minimumTlsVersion', tls, 'supportsHttpsTrafficOnly', https)
